question: Notion task 区间1.618测试 method 10: over 2011-2026 XAUUSD spot, does the first weekly 1618 hold or break more often than the driftless 38.2 percent?
success_criterion: Per direction (hold/break): both halves on that side of 38.2 percent, later one-sided binomial Holm p<0.01, later mean R of that direction's trade >0.
limitations: Spot, not the owner's XAUUSDT.P perp; NY-local HistData M1 converted with DST; daily 17-18 NY break; minute ordering; fee 0; independent R.
